title: SpeechNexusSharedIdentifiers
description: Single source of truth for opaque identifiers, revisions, digests, and the logical resource-pool enum shared by public and internal contracts.

Identifier.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.

Revision.description: Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

EventSequence.description: Monotonic decimal SSE event sequence used as Last-Event-ID.

PoolId.description: Logical capability resource pool identifier. Pools may span multiple host nodes.
